headline: Долги кыргызстанцев перед банками выросли до 410,9 миллиарда сомов
summary: Kyrgyz residents' debts to banks rose to 410.9 billion soms. Banks issued 251 billion soms in consumer loans over the first nine months of 2026, about 33,600 soms per resident.
why: Household debt levels indicate consumer credit demand and the risk exposure of the banking system in Kyrgyzstan.
